subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
8.
As per the understanding of CA Verma, which of the following options, falls
outside the scope of audit of financial statements?
(I)  Assessing the physical condition of industrial buildings and heavy &
sophisticated machinery.
(II)  Examining the reliability and sufficiency of financial information for
audit purposes.
(III)  Determining the suitability of buildings for continued use and estimating
their remaining useful life.
(IV)  Ensuring proper disclosure of property, plant and equipment in the
financial statements.
(A)  (I) and (III)
(B)  (II) and (IV)
(C)  (I), (II) and (III)
(D)  (I) and (II)
(2 Marks)
